title: Latent Instruction Representation Alignment: defending against jailbreaks, backdoors and undesired knowledge in LLMs
raw_excerpt:
作者: Eric Easley, Sebastian Farquhar
摘要: We address jailbreaks, backdoors, and unlearning for large language models (LLMs). Unlike prior work, which trains LLMs based on their actions when given malign instructions, our method specifically trains the model to change how it interprets instructions. Our method, Latent Instruction Representation Alignment (LIRA), greatly improves generalization. We further boost generalization through an internally adversarial training algorithm. Our methods block over 99% of PEZ jailbreak attacks; remove a challenging insecure code backdoor; and achieve optimal forgetting on WMDP cyber with negligible loss of benign capabilities.
summary: 牛津大学提出LIRA方法，通过潜在指令表征对齐防御LLM越狱、后门和遗忘攻击。该方法训练模型改变指令解读方式，而非仅基于恶意指令行为，显著提升泛化性。内部对抗训练进一步强化防御，可阻止99%以上PEZ越狱攻击、移除不安全代码后门并实现最优遗忘效果。

title: Spike-driven Large Language Model
raw_excerpt:
作者: Han Xu, Xuerui Qiu, Baiyu Chen, Xinhao Luo, Xingrun Xing, Jiahong Zhang, Bo Lei, Tiejun Huang, Bo Xu, Guoqi Li
摘要: Current Large Language Models (LLMs) are primarily based on large-scale dense matrix multiplications. Inspired by the brain's information processing mechanism, we explore the fundamental question: how to effectively integrate the brain's spiking-driven characteristics into LLM inference. Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) possess spike-driven characteristics, and some works have attempted to combine SNNs with Transformers. However, achieving spike-driven LLMs with billions of parameters, relying solely on sparse additions, remains a challenge in the SNN field. To address the issues of limited representational capacity and sparsity in existing spike encoding schemes at the LLM level, we propose SDLLM, a spike-driven large language model that eliminates dense matrix multiplications through sparse addition operations. Specifically, we use the plug-and-play gamma-SQP two-step spike encoding method to ensure that the quantization process aligns with the model's semantic space, mitigating representation degradation caused by binary spikes. Furthermore, we introduce bidirectional encoding under symmetric quantization and membrane potential clipping mechanisms, leading to spike trains with no or low firing counts dominating, significantly reducing the model's spike firing rate, while halving the number of time steps. summary: 本文探索将大脑脉冲驱动特性融入LLM推理，提出脉冲驱动大语言模型。当前LLM依赖大规模密集矩阵乘法，而脉冲神经网络（SNN）具有脉冲驱动特性。该工作尝试将SNN与Transformer结合，实现十亿参数级别的脉冲驱动LLM，为低功耗AI推理开辟新路径。

title: Rethinking Generalization in Reasoning SFT: A Conditional Analysis on Optimization, Data, and Model Capability
summary: 本文对推理SFT中的泛化性进行条件分析，从优化、数据和模型能力三个维度重新审视。研究发现，推理SFT的泛化并非简单依赖数据量，而是与优化策略、数据分布和模型初始能力密切相关。该工作为设计更高效的推理微调方法提供了理论指导。

title: ClawBench: Can AI Agents Complete Everyday Online Tasks?
summary: ClawBench是一个评估AI智能体完成日常在线任务能力的基准。它涵盖购物、订餐、信息查询等真实场景，测试智能体在复杂网页交互中的表现。该基准填补了现有评估缺乏真实任务多样性的空白，为开发更实用的AI助手提供标准化测试平台。

title: MolmoWeb: Open Visual Web Agent and Open Data for the Open Web
summary: MolmoWeb是一个开放的视觉网页智能体及配套数据集，旨在推动开放网页上的自主交互。它提供完整的训练数据和模型，使智能体能够理解网页截图并执行点击、输入等操作。该工作降低了网页智能体的研究门槛，促进开放生态发展。

title: Cirrus Labs to join OpenAI
summary: Cirrus Labs宣布加入OpenAI。Cirrus Labs专注于AI基础设施和工具开发，其团队将加入OpenAI以加速下一代AI系统的构建。这一收购反映了OpenAI对强化基础设施能力的重视，也预示着AI行业人才和技术的进一步集中。

title: Tesla's supervised self-driving software gets Dutch okay, first in Europe
summary: 特斯拉的监督式全自动驾驶（FSD）软件获得荷兰批准，成为首个在欧洲获批的国家。该许可允许特斯拉在荷兰道路上测试其FSD系统，但需驾驶员全程监控。这是FSD进入欧洲市场的关键一步，可能加速欧洲自动驾驶法规的演进。

title: AI Is Tipping the Scales Toward Hackers After Mythos Release
summary: NBC新闻报道称，Anthropic发布Claude Mythos后，AI正使黑客占据上风。Mythos的先进能力被用于自动化网络攻击，降低了攻击门槛。安全专家警告，AI工具的普及正在改变攻防平衡，亟需新的防御策略和监管措施。

title: Enforcing new limits and retiring Opus 4.6 Fast from Copilot Pro+
summary: GitHub宣布对Copilot Pro+用户实施新的使用限制，并退役Opus 4.6 Fast模型。此举旨在管理成本并确保服务质量。用户需注意配额变化，而Opus 4.6 Fast的退役可能影响依赖该模型的开发工作流。

title: AI on the couch: Anthropic gives Claude 20 hours of psychiatry
summary: Anthropic让Claude接受20小时真实精神病学治疗，以探索AI的心理健康和安全。该实验旨在通过临床方法评估AI的认知偏差和潜在风险，而非传统红队测试。这一独特尝试可能为AI对齐研究提供新视角。
